root_cause: The social publisher introduced an atomic content_ready -> dispatching claim before provider side effects, but the powerhouse_channel_decisions database check constraint did not include dispatching. Production therefore raised SQLSTATE 23514 immediately after a successful pre-publish review, before capability issuance or provider dispatch.
prevention: Every runtime state transition must be represented in the database state constraint in the same delivery lineage.
Regression-test publisher claim states against the migration that defines allowed database states.
Keep dispatching as the single-writer idempotency barrier before any external provider side effect.
Do not bypass the atomic claim to recover from constraint drift.
